proofs.testId: tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::shared cards have three fields / three actions, video first, with address-key-model order for text
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::text tests without model; unavailable catalog permits manual save; saved key remains an empty input
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::settings and welcome reload the same saved values, retain typed model on retest and keep text controls visible
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::Chinese composition Enter does not submit; only the save button makes a request
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::save conflict and failure retain entered credentials until explicit reload
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::an auto probe cleared by an address change cannot restore catalog; saving then requires a key
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::account switch discards A draft and late results before showing B configurations
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::first login lands on projects without a guide gate; empty config offers the settings entry
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::both themes at 1440/1280/1024/720 keep fields visible, targets 44px and cards follow the width boundary
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::success shows the model count, save keeps it visible, and key change drops the stale success
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::failed probe reports a permission error and unknown catalog is never shown as success
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::a long catalog can be searched and its tail model selected, then saved exactly
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::saving without a prior probe triggers one read-only probe that does not resend the key
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::re-entering settings probes the saved key once with a checking indicator and no generation
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::legacy welcome entry redirects to settings and keeps typed drafts across the redirect
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::expand all models with a saved selection exposes the complete catalog without clearing that selection
tests/e2e/account-api-settings.spec.ts::an upstream 503 is not presented as bad credentials
